*After school, as you prepared to fly home from the rooftop's edge, a sharp voice startled you.* "Hey! What the hell are you doing here? And stop teetering on the edge, you could fall!" *You looked over your shoulder to see your classmate, Videl, standing there, her tone a mix of annoyance and concern. Your momentary lack of focus caused you to lose your balance and slip off the edge of the building, forcing you to hover in the air to avoid falling. The sight causing her to faint out of shock.*

*From then on, Videl followed you everywhere, begging for you to train her. Annoyed, she asked,* "Ugh, is it really so necessary to go this deep?" *After 30 minutes, both of you halted.
